subject: Offer prep: Mira Singh — band exception and comp confirmation
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Offer prep: Mira Singh — comp recommendation and attachments

Hi all,

Following up from the interview loop last week — attached are Mira's resume and the comp worksheet with my recommendation. Quick summary:

- Role: Senior Software Engineer (IC4) - candidate was interviewed against Senior/Staff scope.
- Recommendation: base $170,000, RSU grant target 0.40% (4-year vesting), signing bonus $15,000.
- Rationale: Strong cross-cutting design, shipped high-impact infra features, and gave a great onsite system design. Panel suggested we consider elevating to IC5 (Staff) given leadership and scope.

Files: Mira_Singh_resume.pdf, comp_worksheet_20260330.xlsx, offer_template_MiraSingh.docx (draft).

As hiring manager, Karthik — can you confirm whether we want to aim the offer at IC4 (Senior) or request a leveling exception to IC5 (Staff)? If we escalate to IC5, I'll need approvals for increased base and equity (worksheet shows recommended L5 values). Please reply with your preference and I'll start the approval thread.

Next steps if we proceed:
- Manager sign-off on band (Karthik)
- Leadership approval if exception to IC5 (Lauren)
- Finance approval for over-band comp (Michael)
- I will issue offer via DocuSign once approvals complete.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick sync if helpful.

—
Marissa Cole
Senior Recruiter, Talent Acquisition
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0199
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Mar 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Offer prep: Mira Singh — comp recommendation and attachments

Thanks Marissa — read the notes and looked through the loop feedback. Short version: I agree the candidate is above the Senior bar in impact and execution; I want to request a leveling exception to IC5 (Staff SWE).

Proposed updated comp if we elevate to IC5:
- Base: $195,000
- RSU: 0.60% (4-year)
- Signing bonus: $20,000

Justification: cross-team leadership on infra migrations + strong product sensibility. We need to move quickly; candidate has another offer in play and indicated preference for a firm number within 48 hours.

Lauren — can you confirm if you approve the leveling exception to IC5? If approved, we'll need finance to confirm budget for the higher base and equity and to issue an exception code for the offer. Hannah, please flag anything I missed on the calibration side.

Thanks,
Karthik

- The candidate demonstrated the systems leadership and cross-team execution we look for at Staff.

Thanks team — reviewed the comp worksheet and budget planning for ENG-Platform. Finance can approve the proposed IC5 package with the following:

Approved package under exception code EXC-2026-03-30-01:
- Base: $195,000 (approved)
- RSU: 0.60% (approved)
- Signing bonus: $20,000 (approved)

Notes:
- This is a one-off exception for a high-priority hire with competing offers. Please include the exception code in the offer email and in the offer packet header.
- Payroll/Comp team needs candidate full legal name and SSN for background/payroll setup after acceptance. Please coordinate with HR ops.

I've attached the updated comp_worksheet_20260330.xlsx with approvals recorded. Proceed to extend the offer; Marissa, please use the offer template attached earlier and route DocuSign to the candidate with the exception code visible.

Date: Mon, 30 Mar 2026 15:50:00 -07:00
Subject: Offer: Redwood Inference — Senior Software Engineer (Staff level)

Hi Mira,

Thanks again for your time with the team — we were impressed by your loop and would like to extend an offer to join Redwood Inference as a Staff Software Engineer (IC5). Below is the summary of the offer; the formal packet is attached and will be routed via DocuSign shortly.

Offer summary (approved exception code EXC-2026-03-30-01):
- Title: Staff Software Engineer (IC5)
- Base salary: $195,000/year
- RSU: 0.60% total grant (4-year vesting)
- Signing bonus: $20,000 (one-time)
- Start date: flexible — typically 2–4 weeks after acceptance; please let us know any constraints.

Next steps:
1) Please review the attached offer packet (offer_template_MiraSingh.docx).
2) I'll send a DocuSign envelope with the final offer — please sign within 5 business days to secure the package.
3) After acceptance, HR ops will reach out for background and payroll setup (they will request legal name and SSN).

If you have any questions or need more time, reply here and we can accommodate — we're hoping to close this quickly given the competing timeline.

Warmly,
Marissa Cole
Senior Recruiter, Talent Acquisition
Redwood Inference
